summary: Round-1 finding (defense-in-depth gap on propagated records from arbitrary child loggers, flagged minor by both reviewers and originally marked out-of-scope) is now addressed. The fix is the canonical Python-logging idiom: handler-level filters run for any record dispatched to the handler, including propagated ones, so attaching _TOKEN_FILTER to root.handlers closes the gap. Tests are well-targeted and the regression test correctly avoids caplog (which would have masked the regression).
